item.title: Paired DNA strands recognize shape, not just sequence, in new small-molecule sensing method
item.description: You have probably performed a sandwich assay before, even if you didn't know it. After a sample is dripped onto the test strip, it combines with detector antibodies attached to tiny gold particles, which bind to any viral proteins present. When the sample reaches the test line, a second antibody anchored to the strip binds to a different site on the viral protein, creating a molecular "sandwich."
